utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm — this repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s happening, and I’ll make sure you get the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — so you’ll send me the details when they’re ready?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive — what details do you want me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you check the address, the drop-off spot, and what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll check the address, the drop-off spot, and the start time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane — I’m organizing the repair drive list and can slot you in wherever you’re needed. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, I usually run late anyway — I can help in the afternoon if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Afternoon works great, Dane — I’ll put you down for then. Thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—how’s it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s coming along nicely—folks have been pitching in, and we’re getting a few things fixed up already. If you need a hand, I’ve got a couple tools you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to hear—sounds like people are really pulling together. I might take you up on those tools if I run into anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the next repair to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Let’s start with the fence by the side yard — it’s been leaning for a while.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good call — I’ll grab the tools and head over to the side yard fence.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — if you can, ask them whether they need tools, tape, or someone to help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll ask them what they still need—tools, tape, or help sorting donations. I’ll let you know what they say.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, I’m putting together a repair drive and wanted to see if you’d like to join in. I can send you the details if you’re interested.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, send me the details, Quinn. I like a clear plan, and I can see what I’m able to help with.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send over the details and the schedule right now. Thanks, Eli, I’m glad you’re in!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting some good momentum now—folks seem to be pitching in. If you want, I can pass along the latest details when I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be great, Tess—thanks. I keep meaning to remember the details, but my head’s a bit leaky these days.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Oren — I’ll keep my ear out and pass along anything useful as soon as I hear it. No rush at all.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Pia — I’m juggling school pickup right now, but I can help coordinate the repair drive after that. What time are you hoping to set it for?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Faye — after pickup works for me. I’m just worried about the timing, so if you can send me a window later, I’ll line up the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll send you a time window after pickup so you can line up the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s moving along okay—folks are pitching in, but I still need to sort a few details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to hear it’s moving along. Need any help with the details while I’m out running errands?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think I saw something about it, but I may have missed the details. What changed?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet— I only heard it was being updated. I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Rey. That’d help—I’m a bit out of the loop on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Cleo, did you already figure out what supplies we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I’m checking the list now and I’ll let you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you send me the missing items as soon as you know? I can help grab them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but we should make sure the timing and drop-off details are sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Right, that makes sense — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I should probably get the exact timing and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, let’s confirm the exact time and the drop-off spot first, then we can plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on — I’ve got a few tools set aside and I can bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — you’re definitely bringing them by, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep this simple—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s pretty straightforward: just bring what you can to the repair drive and we’ll sort it out there. I’d say come by around the start time so you don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—I'll come at the start time and bring what I can. If there’s anything you want me to prioritize, let me know ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik — that’d really help. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll let folks know and keep you updated if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word fast and get folks signed up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Quinn — that would help a lot. I’ll get the signup sheet ready and keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Rosa — I’ll start inviting people right away and send them your way to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — we’re still on track. I’ve got a few folks confirmed, and I’m checking on one more volunteer now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — thanks for keeping it moving. If you need me to pick anything up or help set up, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help where I can, but I’ll need to keep it modest this week.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s completely fine, Uli — even a little help goes a long way. Tell me what you can manage this week, and I’ll work around it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can pitch in with a small amount, and I can also help sort or hand out supplies if needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just a few flyers would help a lot, and maybe you could spread the word with the folks on your block.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can print a few flyers and hand them out on my block.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got and see what still needs gathering for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks — just send me the list of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take a quick look and send over the missing supplies list soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect people for the repair drive — who do you want me to reach out to?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you reach out to the folks on Maple and Pine, especially anyone with bikes, small appliances, or tools that need fixing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to the Maple and Pine folks and ask about bikes, small appliances, and tools that need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I keep misplacing the list, but I’m pretty sure we need tape, a couple screwdrivers, and maybe some trash bags. If you’ve got any of that, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got some tape and a screwdriver or two. I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit behind, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll check the list and tell you exactly what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—just let me know, and I’ll bring what I can.
